dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[1001139\_12](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_ts_events/items?event_id=1001139) Tropical storm during the period Jan 28 2025-Jan 31 2025 in Madagascar, French Southern Territories. The center of the storm was located near latitude -31.5 longitude 48.33. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
